items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The main crew was Brecker – was Michael, Grossman, Bob Berg. We were the crew. ... me and Steve were definitely together all the time. We were buds. We were like living together.

ctx.x: When you were doing these loft sessions and concerts, who were some of the young saxophone players besides yourself who were involved in them?

The main crew was Brecker – was Michael, Grossman, Bob Berg. We were the crew. Gary Campbell, another guy – he has been in Florida the last few years – he was there some of the time. We were definitely – me and Steve were definitely together all the time. We were buds. We were like living together. It was, he went to Juilliard. He was done on Wednesday. He’d come home with me. I did my substitute teaching Monday and Tuesday. Took the tie off. We’d drop a little LSD or something of that sort, and we would be…
